concerns.text: FR-024 mandates an a‑priori power analysis targeting ≥80 % power and requires a minimum of 30 observations per species. The original idea only required ≥20 observations per species and did not call for a formal power analysis. This raises the data‑size requirement beyond what the research question explicitly demands.

FR-025 introduces a two‑stage missing‑nutrient policy (>30 % missing → exclusion, ≤30 % → species‑level mean imputation). The idea never specified any missing‑value handling beyond filtering for explicit P and N measurements, so this policy adds unrequested methodology.

FR-026 makes inclusion of additional environmental covariates (soil moisture, temperature, elevation) optional. The idea’s methodology did not mention these covariates; adding them changes the model specification and introduces potential omitted‑variable confounding that was not part of the original research question.

FR-021 requires retrieving peer‑reviewed literature values for expected nutrient effect sizes. The idea’s plan never called for external effect‑size retrieval; this step is extraneous to answering the stated question.

FR-011 mandates a sensitivity analysis against literature‑reported physiological ranges (±10 %). This analysis was not part of the original idea and is not required to test the hypothesised nutrient‑architecture relationship.
FR-028 adds a fallback sensitivity analysis (±15 % variation) when literature ranges are unavailable. This is an additional robustness check not requested in the idea.

FR-022 introduces a post‑report lint step scanning for causal language. The idea only warned against making causal claims in the discussion; a lint step was not specified and constitutes an unnecessary engineering addition.
